description: Register an ephemeral agent with a did:key identity. Short-lived agents that auto-expire. Returns agent_id, did:key, and keypair.

parent_agent_id.description: The agent this worker is spawned for; the worker joins the parent's swarm so swarm budgets, behaviour windows and cascading suspend cover it

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds before the agent auto-expires

name: vorim_register_ephemeral
